name: Sumida (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Sumida ward emblem in white: an outlined downward triangle enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Sumida, a ward in Tokyo; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 15 May 1957.

features.role: Sumida ward emblem — an outlined downward triangle enclosing a stylised character
